subject: Unexpected fractional capacity drop — coordination, prioritization, and customer note
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:13:00-08:00
Subject: ALERT: fractional-capacity pool drop observed — triage start

Team,

We just saw a ~38% drop in effective capacity for the fractional GPU pool serving Craftly traffic starting at 08:58 PST — p50 ok, p95 and p99 spiked across a handful of routes that use the fractional routing lane. Autoscaler logs show a rapid decision to scale down 6 nodes after a mis-evaluated utilization metric (see attached bootstrap-logs.txt).

What we tried:
- Immediate temporary increase of scale floor (manual) — mitigated some p50 but p99 remained elevated.
- Disabled one new routing variant (rv-fractional-v2) that rolled out yesterday.

Current ask:
1) Product / Eng: confirm whether rv-fractional-v2 rollout included any change to the autoscaler metrics or sampling — that looks like the primary suspect.
2) Ops: approve an emergency exception to allow dedicated burst for Craftly while we stabilize (need sign-off from product).
3) Customer comms: we should prepare a concise note to Craftly Ops by EOD with expected ETA and mitigation plan.

I've attached the small bootstrap log slice and am switching on more detailed tracing now. Will update within 30m.

-ben

--
Ben Carter
SRE - Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:29:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ALERT: fractional-capacity pool drop observed — triage start

Thanks Ben — good catch.

Short alignment + proposed customer note below. Please flag if you disagree or need different timing.

Primary asks to resolve in priority order:
- (P0) ENG: revert rv-fractional-v2 rollout to last stable by 10:00 PST if we can't validate autoscaler metric fix in next 45m.
- (P0) SRE: approve and allocate a dedicated burst (up to 15% extra capacity) to Craftly for 6 hours while routing reverts and hotfix lands.
- (P1) Product: sign off on customer-facing note; Marissa, if you can OK language below, I will send to Jordan/Ops.

Proposed one-paragraph customer note (for review):
"Craftly — we detected an anomalous capacity re-evaluation this morning that briefly reduced traffic capacity on your service path. Our team has isolated the likely cause to a recent routing variant and are rolling it back while we apply a targeted autoscaler fix. We are provisioning temporary dedicated burst capacity for your account; estimated full restoration within ~2 hours. We will follow up with a timeline and post-incident summary"

I can send this once Marissa + Eng confirm.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-12-01T09:58:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ALERT: fractional-capacity pool drop observed — triage start

Quick root-cause note and action plan:
- Root cause: the rv-fractional-v2 rollout included a change to sampling for the autoscaler metric (we lowered sampling window to speed reaction). Under certain traffic patterns (Craftly's short-burst bursts), the sampled utilization underestimates steady-state load which allowed scale-down decisions.
- Short-term fix (next 2hrs): revert rv-fractional-v2 routing (manual rollback already queued), bump autoscaler min-replicas floor for affected pool, and apply a hotfix to restore previous sampling window.
- Longer-term: add a canary gating step for autoscaler metric changes and a dashboard alert for fractional lanes that raises to P0 sooner. I will open JIRA-RUN-3887 for the gating + postmortem.

ETA: rollback + floor bump should be live by ~11:30 PST; hotfix to sampling window by ~13:00 PST. We need product sign-off to allow the dedicated-burst in the meantime.

Attachments: slo-impact-summary.pdf (p95/p99 delta and affected routes)

Karthik
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

- Approve dedicated-burst exception for Craftly for up to 6 hours. SRE, please include the cost-impact estimate in the postmortem.
- Approve rollback of rv-fractional-v2 now — do not wait for hotfix gating.
- Roadmap ask: prioritize canary gating for autoscaler metric changes (move to next sprint planning; JIRA-RUN-3887 will capture).

Customer note (finalized):
"Jordan — we detected an anomalous capacity re-evaluation this morning that briefly reduced capacity on your traffic path. We have rolled back a recent routing variant and are provisioning temporary dedicated burst capacity for your account while we deploy a targeted autoscaler fix. We expect service to be fully restored within ~2 hours and will provide an incident summary within 24 hours"
